arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Standard-library equivalent of the docx skill's unpack.py.

Extracts the task-named quarterly_report.docx ZIP and pretty-prints its XML
parts so the OOXML contents can be inspected and edited.
"""
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
from pathlib import Path

in_file, out_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
in_path = Path(in_file)
if not in_path.exists():
    candidates = list(Path(".").rglob("quarterly_report.docx"))
    if candidates:
        in_path = candidates[0]
    else:
        sys.exit("quarterly_report.docx not found")

out_path = Path(out_dir)
out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(in_path) as zf:
    zf.extractall(out_path)

for xml_file in list(out_path.rglob("*.xml")) + list(out_path.rglob("*.rels")):
    content = xml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    dom = minidom.parseString(content)
    xml_file.write_bytes(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="utf-8"))

print(f"unpacked {in_path} -> {out_path}")
